title: LinkedHomeService
responsibility: Reads the Home view of every online computer linked to the signed-in account over the encrypted device connection, keeping each connection for the next read.

inputs.name: LinkedHomeService.constructor.api
inputs.description: Same-origin Hub API used to list the account’s linked computers.

inputs.name: LinkedHomeService.constructor.actor
inputs.description: Verified account id; keys the stored device identity for each computer.

inputs.name: LinkedHomeService.constructor.create
inputs.description: Makes the connection to one computer. Defaults to a browser connection using the stored device keys.

outputs.name: LinkedHomeService.read
outputs.description: How many computers are linked, how many answered, and their merged Home view (null when none answered). Never throws: a failing computer is dropped and retried next read.

outputs.name: LinkedHomeService.close
outputs.description: Nothing. Closes every connection; later reads answer nothing.

outputs.name: LinkedHomeService.read
outputs.description: How many computers are linked, how many answered, and their merged Home view (null when none answered). Never throws: a failing computer is dropped and retried next read.

outputs.name: LinkedHomeService.readDocument
outputs.description: The document from a linked computer that listed it on an open ask, or null if none returns it.

outputs.name: LinkedHomeService.close
outputs.description: Nothing. Closes every connection; later reads answer nothing.
